title: Symmetric subrank and its border analogue
summary: The symmetric subrank of homogeneous polynomial is the largest number of terms in a diagonal form to which it can be specialized by a (typically non-invertible) linear variable substitution. Building on earlier work by Derksen-Makam-Zuiddam and Biaggi-Chang-Draisma-Rupniewski for ordinary tensors, we determine the asymptotic behavior of symmetric subrank and symmetric border subrank of degree-d forms as the number of variables tends to infinity.
